title: WebsitePolicy
description: website.policy@1: how a Share decides who may reach it and under what conditions (public, OpenVibe sign-in, named people or projects, password, one-time link, expiry), plus IP/country rules, rate limits, a bot check, a WAF preset and required device posture. mode is the only field required except that expiry also requires a non-null expires_at. id, owner and version are present when Connect returns a stored policy. Password and one-time policies stay inactive until their credential or link is configured through the CON-5 API. A password is stored as a one-way hash beside this record and is never part of this document; password_set only says one exists.

id.description: Present on a stored policy; omitted when the policy is written inline with a new share.

owner.description: The person who owns the policy; set from the token when a policy is created.

project_id.description: The project scope, when the policy belongs to one.

mode.description: public: anyone with the link after the abuse screen; signin: any OpenVibe account (optionally a project); named: allowed_subjects/allowed_projects only; password: a shared password; one_time: single-use links; expiry: public access only until expires_at. An expires_at may also cap any other mode.

allowed_subjects.description: Explicit people or agents allowed in named mode; a project's members are allowed through allowed_projects instead.

allowed_projects.description: Projects whose members may reach a named or signin share.

ip_allow.description: CIDR ranges allowed before any other rule; empty means no IP allowlist.

ip_deny.description: CIDR ranges always refused; evaluated before the allowlist.

country_allow.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes allowed; empty means all.

waf_preset.description: Defense in depth at the edge; Cloudflare's managed rules run in front of it for HTTP/WS.

posture_required.description: Self-reported device posture a share may require; a signal, not a guarantee.

password_set.description: Read-only: true when a password hash exists. The hash itself never leaves Connect.

password_hint.description: An optional hint shown on the password page; never the password.

one_time_max_uses.description: For one_time mode; 1 unless the owner allows more.

session_ttl_seconds.description: How long a host-only __Host-ov_session on the share host stays valid after sign-in.

expires_at.description: The absolute end of the policy; required and non-null for expiry mode, optional for other modes.

version.description: The signed policy version the edge caches and checks on every request; present on a stored policy.
